identity.description: Separates nominal yield from inflation, dilution pressure, supply dynamics, and market-cap context. Computes real-yield proxies and flags tokens where high nominal rewards are eroded by emission schedules or supply unlocks.

capabilities.dataCoverage: 59 assets, inflation rate, FDV/MCAP, circulating supply, market cap change

inputs.description: Sustainability question with optional asset filter and inflation/dilution thresholds.

outputs.description: Nominal-yield, inflation, dilution, and supply report with sustainability flags.

mustWarn: not true net yield without fees, price path, lockups, and reward composition
skill.userValue: Compare nominal yield with inflation, dilution, supply, and market-cap context to assess sustainability questions. Check reward composition, unlock schedules, fees, lockups, and price exposure using current primary sources.
